span.p:
Nothing on this diagram can change the QUEUE.
Routing was settled by the menu before begin()
was called (D37), so DECLINED and IGNORED are
outcomes, not failures - the agent still gets a
menu-derived brief, with the reason attached.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span:
The machine has NO I/O (B7). Every arrow that
fires because time passed - both silences, the
max duration, the re-offer - is an ordinary
method call, so each one has a test in which
nothing happens except the clock moving. And the driver STOPS at the answer (D88): the three arrows out of RECORDING all arrive from outside, seconds later, on another connection.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
finalize_reason travels on the outcome, and
NO_CONSENT is the honest default: the reason
there is no transcript is that we were never
allowed one, and the brief has to say so (D14).
